summary: On-demand temporal SIEM slice and entity-field mapping for PCI forensic evidence
description: Issue summary: TruLedger is performing a PCI forensic review after a suspected anomalous request pattern on 2026-03-01. They request an ordered, time-bounded export (2026-03-01T12:00:00Z to 2026-03-01T16:00:00Z) for tenant_id=truledger-prod-42. Deliverable must include a field mapping CSV, event ordering (monotonic sequence), per-event CRC32, and an HMAC-SHA256 signed manifest. Required fields: event_id, timestamp_utc, request_id, tenant_id, user_id (hashed with customer-supplied salt), ip_address (prefix-preserved), user_agent, model_name, prompt_hash, response_metadata.status, audit_event_type, kv_cache_hit, and route_variant. Redaction: PII must be pseudonymized using SHA-256 with the provided salt (do not return raw PII). Delivery: SFTP to provided host with object-lock enabled OR presigned S3 URL expiry 7 days. Impact: Regulatory timeline; evidence must be delivered to TruLedger SOC and retained for 90 days with integrity proof. Environment: prod, us-west-2 (dedicated capacity). Steps to reproduce: N/A — this is an ad-hoc export request (forensic). We do have a suggested Kibana query but customer needs a canonical export with resume token and corruption-proof manifest. Logs & references: see support log bundle link and Kibana query given in first comment. Workaround provided: initial 1-hour Kibana slice (delivered) but customer requires full ordered export and signed manifests for compliance.

investigation_notes: Initial run generated 3,624 events for the window; 14 events failed schema validation due to empty response_metadata.status — likely from a worker restart during that shard's processing.

KV cache hits/ misses checked; no evidence of data loss in storage layer. Events present in raw storage but failed validation during transform step. Need a one-off transform re-run for those event files.

Proposed plan: (1) Re-run transform on affected shards with tolerant parser to populate response_metadata.status as 'unknown' where missing, (2) Regenerate CRC32 and manifest, (3) Apply HMAC and upload to customer SFTP, (4) Create a conformance note documenting the schema mismatch and remediation steps.

Related runbook: confluence page for ad-hoc forensic exports (link in related_confluence_pages). Engineering prep: small code patch to parser to avoid dropping fields on transient worker errors; PR referenced above.
resolution: In progress: Engineering to re-run transform on 2026-03-13 morning window; planned delivery of signed SFTP bundle with manifest and field-mapping CSV by 2026-03-13 18:00 UTC. Follow-up action: schedule recurring daily delta export for TruLedger for 7 days and PR to add defensive parser behavior into serving runtime. Post-delivery, create a short post-incident note and update internal runbook.
notes: Deliverable must not include raw PII. Ensure presigned upload option if SFTP cannot be provisioned by customer.
